name: Pressing midfield
engine: While their midfield has legs it presses yours every moment: your midfield options cost more and are resisted.
about: An opponent build. While their midfield has 50 stamina or more it presses yours every moment, at 6 stamina a moment: your midfield options cost 4 more, the first decision after you win the ball is +1 to them, and a duel you lose in midfield gives them +1 next. It taxes Defend deep, break fast (the break starts in midfield), and it fades if you tire them.
